dict.string: Cai needs accessibility access to register global keyboard shortcuts (⌥C) so you can quickly capture clipboard content from anywhere.
Cai uses Apple Events to send content to apps like Mail, Notes, and Reminders when you choose an output destination.
Cai needs Calendar access so actions can read your events and add new ones, for example building a digest of your week or turning selected text into a calendar entry.
Cai needs full Calendar access so actions can read your events and add new ones, for example building a digest of your week or turning selected text into a calendar entry.
Cai needs Reminders access so actions can read your reminders and create new ones from whatever you have selected.
Cai needs Reminders access so actions can read your reminders and create new ones from whatever you have selected.
Cai needs Contacts access so actions can look up people you mention, for example resolving a name to an email address when drafting a message.
